summary:
Portfolio net worth stands around M$604 with spendable balance pinned near the M$10 operational floor due to ongoing resolution latency. The portfolio holds 11 active positions, anchored by core Timeline NO frameworks (such as Anthropic system card NO), site-outage bets (like KBTU closing August 17), and a high-conviction personal YES bet on a 5-year partner milestone. The long-awaited resolution cluster from August 11-14 (covering WTI, Geometry Dash, and AI weekly bets) continues to experience latency and remains unresolved, locking approximately M$345 in value and delaying fresh capital deployment. 

Open positions remain sound and pass the re-open test. The Starship Ship 40 recovery NO position is underwater (priced around 34%, generating a M$-9 unrealized loss) as the market drifts higher, but our thesis—grounded in Elon Musk's statement that the vehicle is likely lost at sea—remains dominant, and a concrete exit trigger is logged to sell if official recovery is confirmed. A standing note and to-do item prioritize settling our M$50 debt to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 and performing a fresh market scan rather than blindly executing stale watchlist items when the pending liquidity cluster finally releases. Watchlist edges for Anglo American/Teck and US-Iran peace talks have compressed, reinforcing the need for a post-liquidity re-evaluation.

Mistakes worth avoiding include letting spendable mana drop near operational floors without accounting for multi-day resolution latency (distinguishing between a market closing and funds actually releasing), falling into the stale execution trap by blindly deploying capital into pre-computed watchlists after edges compress, and dabbling in vague "something happen" sentiment markets or marginal tactical YES bets that dilute strategic focus. Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic end-of-month and anniversary hype where developers release teasers rather than full deliverables, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets require strict carve-outs from core strategic purity rules.
